description.value: As a summoner gains experience, he learns a number of talents that assist him in manipulating spells and other forms of magic. At 2nd level and every two summoner levels thereafter, a summoner gains one summon talent. A summoner cannot select an individual talent more than once. Talents marked with an asterisk add effects to a summoner's spellcasting ability. Only one of these talents can be applied to an individual spell and the decision must be made before the spell is cast. A complete list of summon talents is detailed on a separate reference page.
